gaps.title: No Structured Algorithm Negotiation Export from TLS

evidence.quote: The client offers its set of supported cipher suites in the ClientHello.
evidence.relevance: TLS 1.3 negotiates algorithms in handshake but no export mechanism is defined.

evidence.quote: The DNSKEY resource record stores a public key.
evidence.relevance: DNSKEY carries algorithm ID per zone but no resolver aggregation/export standard exists.

gaps.title: No Certificate Algorithm Inventory in OCSP/CRL

evidence.quote: The OCSP client issues a request to an OCSP server and suspends acceptance of the certificate until the server provides a response.
evidence.relevance: OCSP carries revocation status, not algorithm family inventory.

gaps.title: No PQC Readiness Signal in QUIC Transport

evidence.quote: QUIC uses TLS 1.3 for connection establishment.
evidence.relevance: QUIC inherits TLS gap-1 plus adds header encryption reducing passive observability.

gaps.title: No Aggregated Readiness State Export Protocol

evidence.relevance: No IETF-standard protocol aggregates per-session Algorithm Negotiation Records into environment-level PQC Readiness State. CBOM addresses software inventory, not network-layer aggregation.

cbom_differentiation.cbom_scope: Software composition and supply-chain cryptographic library inventory at build/install time
cbom_differentiation.this_document_scope: Network-layer observability gaps: missing signals at session/protocol negotiation time
cbom_differentiation.complementarity: REQ-RG-5 requires interoperability with CBOM, not replacement of it
